behavior: 7 built-in drivers: agent, bun, ci, container, node, remote, shell; backendIds() gives back this exact sorted list
DEFAULT_BACKEND_ID is "node"; exactly one driver has default:true
Backend id when no flag is given; an unknown value throws BackendError backend-not-found with message 'Unknown execution backend in CW_BACKEND: <id>'
resolveBackendSelection: flag > CW_BACKEND env > default; result carries source flag|env|default
registerBackend(driver) adds/overrides a driver by spec.id; it then shows up in list/ids/descriptor/probe/run with no central switch edit
Canonical evidence: command:<cmd+args>, exitCode:<int|null>, stdoutSha256:sha256:<64hex> — byte-stable shape across all real backends
Refused envelope evidence: refused:<code>, backend:<id>, sandbox:<profileId>; no stdoutSha256 line
ExecutionResultEnvelope { schemaVersion:1, status: completed|failed|refused, result{summary,findings,evidence}, evidence, provenance{schemaVersion:1,backendId,locality,kind,attestation,handle?} }
Summaries: '<label>: completed (exit 0)', '<label>: failed (exit <code>)', '<label>: failed (<spawnError>)', '<label>: refused (<code>) — <reason>'
sha256() gives 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex chars of the utf8 input
runBackend gate order: command policy, attestation unenforceable, delegate, readiness, no-command, executeLocal
A command denied by profile (mode none, or allowlist miss on the exact joined string) refuses with code sandbox-command-denied
A required dimension the driver marks unsupported refuses with sandbox-unenforceable and lists the dimensions
A local backend whose probe is not ready refuses with backend-not-ready
A local run (or a non-commandless delegate) with no command refuses with no-command
A delegating backend with no handle (no image/endpoint/agent config) refuses with delegation-target-missing
Unknown backend id throws BackendError code backend-not-found: 'Execution backend not found: <id>' with available ids in details
attestSandbox mode delegate-host: write becomes enforce, every other supported dimension becomes attest (the dispatch-path default)
Attestation status: refused when any unenforceable or not ready; enforced when any dimension enforced; else attested
read+write always required; command iff execute.mode!=any; network iff network.mode!=any; env iff env.inherit===false
shell driver joins command+args and runs with shell:true via /bin/sh; node/bun spawn direct argv with shell:false

shell driver throws 'Shell backend refused: args contain shell control characters. Use the node, bun, or agent backend instead for untrusted inputs.' when the joined string (minus {{tokens}}) matches [;&|`$(){}<>!\n\r#*?~]
TTY-only stderr frames a local run: '● Running <basename>...' then '✓ Done (<ms>ms)'
bun driver executes via the node-compatible path; only the provenance runtime note differs: 'bun (node-compatible execution)' vs 'node-compatible (bun not installed)'
container picks docker then podman off PATH; none present refuses runtime-unavailable 'no container runtime (docker/podman) on PATH'
Daemon pre-flight '<runtime> version --format {{.Server.Version}}' (15s); dead daemon refuses runtime-unavailable, never a fake command result
Container argv: run --rm [--network none if network.mode!=any] -v <cwd>:<cwd>:ro -w <cwd> [-e NAME=VALUE per exposed name, skipping PATH/HOME] <ref> <cmd> <args>
Exit 125 or null from the runtime is a runtime-unavailable refusal ('<runtime> could not run the container: ...'), distinct from the command's own non-zero exit which is a failed envelope
Container image for the handle (with optional CW_CONTAINER_DIGEST); ref is image@digest or image; absent = delegation-target-missing
remote endpoint (with optional CW_REMOTE_JOB); ref endpoint#jobId or endpoint; absent = unverified probe + delegation-target-missing run
ci endpoint (with optional CW_CI_JOB); at least one of endpoint/job must be set for a handle
remote/ci POST job JSON {command,args,env,sandboxProfileId,jobId} via the packaged http-delegate-child (spawned by path, shell:false, CW_DELEGATE_ENDPOINT set); timeout request.timeoutMs||120000
Child prints ONE JSON object: {"exitCode":n,"stdout":"..."} or {"error":"..."}; polls a returned jobId every 1s up to 600 times until done:true
Spawn error, unparseable child stdout, child error field, or missing numeric exitCode all refuse with delegation-failed
delegateChildScript() throws 'Delegate child script not found at <path>. This indicates a broken installation — ...' when the shipped script is absent (checked at import time)
Agent command template; split on white space into binary+argv template, never shell-read; supports builtin:<name>
Agent HTTP endpoint (alternative to a command template); manifest job POSTed through the http delegate child
Operator model policy interpolated into {{model}}; recorded only in secret-stripped args; NEVER the attested/reported model
Agent timeout config layer (Number); the spawn default is 600000ms
Operator trust PUBLIC key (inline PEM or path) for verifying agent-signed telemetry; not a secret
Opt-in fail-closed gate: a hop whose telemetry verdict is not attested throws telemetry-unattested-blocked before any accept-side mutation; boolish 1/true/yes/on vs 0/false/no/off
=1 turns off agent auto-detect from PATH

When nothing is configured, the FIRST of claude, codex, gemini, opencode found as a file on PATH (and present in builtin-templates.json) is used as builtin:<name>; source becomes 'auto'; model hint 'builtin:<name>'

builtin:<name> expands to 'node <agentsDir>/<script> {{input}} {{result}}' from scripts/agents/builtin-templates.json; unknown name throws 'Unknown builtin agent template "<name>" — available: <names>'
Shipped builtin names: claude, codex, gemini (via opencode), gemini-cli, opencode, deepseek
resolveAgentConfig: per-field flags > env > file > auto-detect > none; source names the layer the command/endpoint came from
$CW_HOME/agent-config.json — durable config, secret-stripped, atomic temp→rename, 2-space JSON + ending newline; corrupt file treated as absent
agentConfigShow: { schemaVersion:1, configured, source, config(secret-stripped), path, fileExists } — deterministic, no time-derived field (CLI<->MCP parity)
Agent spawned argv-style: spawnSync(binary, substitutedArgs, {shell:false, stdio:[ignore,pipe,inherit|pipe], timeout: timeoutMs||600000, maxBuffer:32MiB})
{{manifest}} {{input}} {{result}} {{workerDir}} {{model}} {{prompt}} substitute into DISCRETE argv elements; unknown {{key}} stays literal; keys are \w+ only

Agent child env = buildChildEnv(policy) baseline + re-allowed names matching ^(CW_|ANTHROPIC_|OPENAI_|GEMINI_|DEEPSEEK_|CODEX_|GOOGLE_|COHERE_|MISTRAL_|OLLAMA_|AZURE_|AWS_)/i — the agent's own keys resolve; CW never reads them
buildChildEnv: inherit=true copies process.env; else PATH+HOME + expose list − deny list only
Live stderr gate: CW_NO_STREAM=1 forces off (wins), CW_AGENT_STREAM=0 off, =1 on even piped, else follows isTTY
Agent child with null exit (timeout/kill) refuses delegation-failed 'agent process returned no exit code (timed out or killed)' — never a made-up completion
Agent spawn error refuses delegation-failed 'agent process failed to spawn: <err>'
No command-template AND no endpoint refuses delegation-target-missing 'Backend agent has no command-template or endpoint configured'

backend probe agent: configured => ready; unconfigured => unverified + ready:false + reason 'no agent configured (set CW_AGENT_COMMAND or CW_AGENT_ENDPOINT, or pass --agent-command/--agent-endpoint)' — same shape as unconfigured remote, never a refusal

Agent handle kind 'process', ref = binary + stripped args joined by space (or endpoint), metadata {mode, command, args(stripped), model, reportedModel, reportedUsage?, usageSignature?} — provenance only, never evidence
reportedModel comes ONLY from parseAgentReport of the child's stdout; blank/absent => the exact string 'unreported'; never backfilled from CW_AGENT_MODEL

parseAgentReport: whole stdout as JSON or the LAST {...} line; model from model|usage.model|modelId, else the modelUsage key with most inputTokens/input_tokens; also usage + usageSignature|usage_signature

stripSecretArgs: value after --api-key/--apikey/--token/--key/--secret/--password/--auth/--bearer => '<redacted>'; inline --x-(key|token|secret|password|auth|bearer)*=v => '<flag>=<redacted>'; bare sk-/ghp_/gho_/github_pat_/xox[abpr]-/'Bearer ' prefixes or 32+ char [A-Za-z0-9_-] runs with no path separator => '<redacted>'

Endpoint agent: job {manifest,prompt,model,resultPath,sandboxProfileId} via the http delegate child (timeout||600000); a returned result body is written to result.md ONLY when extracted, report.usage undefined, and the file absent; evidence command 'agent-endpoint' with the endpoint as its one arg
extractEndpointResult: JSON 'result' or 'resultMarkdown' string field; non-JSON stdout is taken raw as the body; JSON without those keys gives nothing
request.preparedAgentOutcome (Track 2) skips the spawn and settles through the exact same refusal/evidence branches — identical envelopes by construction
runAgentBatchOutcomes: ONE spawnSync of batch-delegate-child, jobs JSON on stdin, maxBuffer 34MiB×jobs, backstop timeout max(job timeouts)+30000, stdout kept as a raw Buffer
Batch child streams one NDJSON line per job the moment it settles: {"i":<index>,"spawnError"?,"exitCode":n|null,"stdout"}; bad stdin JSON => one-element error array; empty jobs => []

Per-job SIGTERM at timeoutMs, SIGKILL at +5000ms; a kill yields exitCode null (the no-exit-code refusal); stderr is drained; per-job stdout cap 32MiB (over-cap => spawnError 'stdout exceeded <CAP> byte cap (<n> bytes)')

reconcileBatchOutcomes splits on the raw 0x0a byte on a Buffer, decodes line-at-a-time, drops the trailing part, skips corrupt/out-of-range lines; jobs with no full line get spawnError 'batch delegate failed: <reason>'; a landed line keeps its real outcome
node probe: check 'node-runtime'; unavailable with reason 'node runtime not found on PATH' when node is off PATH
shell probe: 'posix-shell' — sh on PATH or /bin/sh exists; reason 'POSIX shell not found'
bun probe: checks bun-runtime + node-compatible-fallback; ready when either; reason 'bun not installed; executing via node-compatible runtime'
container probe: docker + podman checks; reason 'no container runtime (docker/podman) found; supply --image to delegate explicitly'
remote/ci probes: endpoint env + delegate-child-script checks; no endpoint => unverified; missing script => unavailable 'delegate child script is missing'
Probe cache TTL for backendProbePayload, default 60000ms, keyed by id:cwd; 0 disables
backendListPayload: { schemaVersion:1, default:'node', backends: sorted descriptors }; probe-all payload { schemaVersion:1, default:'node', probes:[...] }
4 bundled profiles: default, readonly, workspace-write, locked-down with the exact read/write/output/execute/network/env values in BUNDLED_PROFILE_DEFINITIONS
An unknown profile id fails closed: SandboxProfileError sandbox-profile-not-found 'Sandbox profile not found: <id>' — never a quiet fall to default
A non-bundled id that is a readable file under cwd is validated + enforced as a custom profile; path escape outside cwd => sandbox-profile-path-escape; invalid => sandbox-profile-invalid with issues
A custom profile FILE whose id reuses a bundled name is invalid: 'Custom sandbox profile id "<id>" is reserved (collides with a bundled profile); choose a different id'
After snapshot loss a custom logical id re-resolves from run.customSandboxProfiles against the WORKER's own context (worker-correct path tokens) — bundled and on-disk branches first

Path tokens $cwd $runDir $workerDir $inputPath $resultPath $artifactsDir $logsDir; unknown/unbound token => 'Unknown or unavailable sandbox path token: <t>'; '..' segments and control chars always denied
validateSandboxWrite: traversal, control chars, then realpath containment vs writePaths + allowed worker output paths; violation { code:'sandbox-write-denied', message, path, allowedPaths }
isContainedPath realpaths both sides — a symlink whose text looks inside but whose real target escapes is denied
validateSandboxCommand/-Network: malformed (empty/control chars), mode none, or exact-string allowlist miss give sandbox-command-denied / sandbox-network-denied violations
Every resolved policy carries the fixed enforcedByCW (4 items) and hostRequired (5 items) lists; under node the execute/network/env policy is attested, not enforced
Normalization: execute.mode and network.mode default to 'none' when absent; env.inherit coerces to boolean; workerOutput defaults true/true/true with context overrides
.cw/runs/<run>/workers/<worker>/{worker.json,manifest.json,input.md,result.md,artifacts/,logs/} + workers/index.json
createWorkerId: 'worker-<safeTaskId>-<4-digit seq>' — count of same-prefix scopes + 1; replays give byte-identical ids
Re-allocating a failed/orphaned scope bumps retryCount, clears errors, resets status, reuses the same id/dir
input.md is a fixed markdown: '# Worker <id>', run/task/dispatch/result/artifacts/logs/sandbox lines, '## Task' with the prompt, '## Boundary' with read/write paths and the do-not-mutate line
manifest.json carries 7 fixed instruction lines starting 'Read input.md before doing work.' plus sandbox{profileId,policy,enforcedByCW,hostRequired} and backend attestation blocks

recordWorkerOutput fixed step order: validateWorkerResult → attestWorkerDelegation → acceptWorkerResult → recordWorkerDelegationLedger → runWorkerVerify → recordWorkerCompletion → fanOutWorkerOutput; do NOT reorder
A result outside the write boundary records a denied path audit + worker failure (scope status 'rejected') and throws the violation message before any accept-side mutation
A missing result file fails retryable with code worker-result-missing: 'Worker result file does not exist: <path>'
Default ON: file-style evidence locators must resolve on disk (code worker-evidence-unresolvable when not); '0/false/no/off' restores shape-only; 'url' also checks URL reachability
With requireAttestedTelemetry on, a verdict other than 'attested' throws telemetry-unattested-blocked pre-mutation; default (off) records and labels, never blocks

Accepted result.md is copied to <resultsDir>/<safeTaskId>.md; the task completes with loopStage 'observe'; result node id '<run>:result:<task>'; agent provenance folds into node metadata, never evidence
A result with no findings AND no evidence gets captureWarning 'no findings or evidence captured from result.md' in node metadata + a worker.capture-warning audit event — surfaced, not blocked here

The telemetry verdict is bound into the hash-chained ledger BEFORE the worker.agent-delegation audit event so the event cross-links recordId/recordHash/prevHash; the signed result digest is stored only when the signature covered it

Scope status becomes 'verified' when the verify stage returns 'advanced', else 'completed'; outputDigest = sha256(rawResult) + outputSizeBytes recorded; UsageRecord (source 'host-attested') only when the agent reported model or usage

recordWorkerFailure: boundary/sandbox-* codes => scope 'rejected' and audit decision 'denied'; anything else => 'failed'; task goes failed/adjust with an error node '<run>:worker:<id>:failure:<n>' + feedback

reclaimOrphans marks allocated/running scopes past their positive timeoutMs as 'orphaned' with retryable error worker-orphaned 'Worker exceeded timeout of <t>ms (elapsed: <e>ms).'; pure function of now+state
A corrupt worker.json in a listing is skipped with stderr 'cw: skipping unreadable worker scope <file>: <msg>'; a direct read throws 'Corrupt worker scope <file>: <msg>'

Wrapper seam: argv {{input}}={worker input.md} {{result}}={worker result.md}; the wrapper writes result.md itself and prints ONE stdout JSON line {model,usage,result}; failed hops drop stderr to logs/agent-stderr.log; stream mode writes transcript.md
Wrappers exit 2 on bad argv (usage line on stderr), 1 on spawn/parse/no-result failure, and pass the vendor child's exit through; no result event => refuse to make one up

CW imports no model SDK, holds no API key, builds no model API request; agents run out-of-process (spawnSync shell:false) or behind a plain-HTTP child; keys flow only through the agent's own inherited env

The drive BLOCKS (refuses to spawn) with reason 'agent backend not configured (set CW_AGENT_COMMAND/CW_AGENT_ENDPOINT or pass --agent-command/--agent-endpoint) — refusing rather than fabricating a completion' when agentConfigured() is false
classifyRemote: no scheme/scp/helper marker => 'local' (never fetched); \.(tar\.gz|tgz|tar|zip)$ path => 'archive'; else 'git'; scp form git@host:owner/repo counts as git
Allowed schemes https/http/ssh/git/file; ext::/fd:: helpers, '-'-leading values, and unknown schemes throw the exact messages before any subprocess
validateRemoteUrl gives { ok, kind, url(sanitized), reason? } with NO network I/O — the --check path; local => reason 'not a recognized remote URL (expected https/ssh/git/file or git@host:repo)'
URL userinfo is stripped before print/persist/cache-key; the raw URL exists only as one git argv element; all git/download diagnostics pass redactCredentials first
$CW_HOME/clones/<first 24 hex of sha256(url\0ref)>/ holds the checkout + .cw-clone-meta.json {url,kind,ref,commit,fetchedAt}; clone/extract targets must sit inside clones/ (containment asserted)

git clone argv: clone --depth 1 --single-branch [--branch <ref>] -c core.hooksPath= -- <rawUrl> <dir>; env GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, GIT_ASKPASS=, GCM_INTERACTIVE=never; 120s default timeout; commit = resolved HEAD SHA
An existing .git dir with no refresh flag reuses the cache (cached:true); a corrupt entry falls through to a fresh clone; the key is URL+ref, not content — --refresh re-fetches
Archive caps: 200 MiB download (MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES), 1 GiB extracted (MAX_EXTRACTED_BYTES); declared size (gzip ISIZE / unzip -l) checked BEFORE extraction, actual tree size after
Entry names checked for ../absolute escape before extraction; the extracted tree is lstat-walked and fails closed on symlinks and non-regular entries
http(s) archive fetch follows redirects BY HAND (max 6) in a node child, re-checking each hop: http(s) scheme only + no private/loopback/link-local host; child exit codes 2-6 name the failure

Extracted tree (one-dir wrapper stepped into) is moved into the cache slot and git init + add -A + commit --allow-empty -m 'snapshot of <url>' with identity user.email=cw@local user.name=cw; commit = sha256 hex of the downloaded bytes

quickstart: --link <url> (or a URL in --repo) materializes AFTER --check and BEFORE plan; args.repo is rewritten to the local path; sourceUrl/sourceCommit/sourceRef ride into run.inputs; a source.clone/source.download audit event is recorded; the JSON result gains remote{url,commit,kind,cached,ref?}
Home root: CW_HOME > XDG_STATE_HOME/cool-workflow > ~/.local/state/cool-workflow — holds agent-config.json and clones/
Child-only: the endpoint the http delegate child POSTs to; missing => the child answers {"error":"no endpoint"}
allocateWorkerScope records backendId/backendSelection/backendAttestation (mode delegate-host) ONLY when a backend was named; worker.sandbox-profile and worker.backend trust-audit events are recorded
buildAgentRequest is the ONE builder for drive delegations: backendId task.agentType||'agent', delegation {command,args,endpoint,model: task.model||config.model}; serial and batch rounds share it
Only the agent driver sets commandlessDelegate — its command rides in the handle, so runBackend does not demand request.command for it
